statement: WITH channels AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(channel_id AS STRING) AS channel_id FROM prod_tads.youtube_too.yt_sl_channels WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL), raw_categories AS (SELECT CAST(canonical_id AS STRING) AS channel_id, topic_categories, collected_at, collected_date FROM dev_sean.default.channel_category WHERE canonical_id IS NOT NULL), latest AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_categories FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.channel_id ORDER BY r.collected_at DESC, r.collected_date DESC) AS rn FROM raw_categories r INNER JOIN channels c ON r.channel_id = c.channel_id) WHERE rn = 1), exploded AS (SELECT l.channel_id, pos, CASE WHEN cat RLIKE '/wiki/' THEN regexp_replace(regexp_extract(cat, '/wiki/(.*)$', 1), '%20', '_') ELSE cat END AS topic_category FROM latest l LATERAL VIEW posexplode(array_distinct(filter(coalesce(l.topic_categories, CAST(array() AS ARRAY<STRING>)), x -> x IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(x)) > 0))) e AS pos, cat), mapped AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN topic_category IN ('Christian_music','Classical_music','Country_music','Electronic_music','Hip_hop_music','Independent_music','Jazz','Music_of_Asia','Music_of_Latin_America','Pop_music','Reggae','Rhythm_and_blues','Rock_music','Soul_music') THEN 'Music' WHEN topic_category IN ('Action_game','Action-adventure_game','Casual_game','Music_video_game','Puzzle_video_game','Racing_video_game','Role-playing_video_game','Simulation_video_game','Sports_game','Strategy_video_game') THEN 'Video_game_culture' WHEN topic_category IN ('American_football','Baseball','Basketball','Boxing','Cricket','Association_football','Golf','Ice_hockey','Mixed_martial_arts','Motorsport','Tennis','Volleyball') THEN 'Sport' WHEN topic_category IN ('Humour','Film','Performing_arts','Professional_wrestling','Television_program') THEN 'Entertainment' WHEN topic_category IN ('Fashion','Physical_fitness','Food','Hobby','Pet','Physical_attractiveness','Technology','Tourism','Vehicle') THEN 'Lifestyle_(sociology)' WHEN topic_category IN ('Business','Health','Military','Politics','Religion') THEN 'Society' ELSE NULL END AS parent_category FROM exploded), child_rows AS (SELECT * FROM mapped WHERE parent_category IS NOT NULL), parent_positions AS (SELECT channel_id, topic_category AS parent_category, MIN(pos) AS parent_pos FROM mapped WHERE topic_category IN ('Music','Video_game_culture','Sport','Entertainment','Lifestyle_(sociology)','Society') GROUP BY channel_id, topic_category), joined AS (SELECT c.topic_category AS child_category, c.parent_category, c.channel_id, c.pos AS child_pos, p.parent_pos FROM child_rows c LEFT JOIN parent_positions p ON c.channel_id = p.channel_id AND c.parent_category = p.parent_category) SELECT child_category, parent_category, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id) AS n_child_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN parent_pos IS NOT NULL THEN channel_id END) AS n_with_parent, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN parent_pos IS NOT NULL THEN channel_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id), 2) AS pct_with_parent, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN parent_pos IS NOT NULL AND parent_pos < child_pos THEN channel_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN parent_pos IS NOT NULL THEN channel_id END), 0), 2) AS pct_parent_before_child_when_present, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN child_pos = 0 THEN channel_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT channel_id), 2) AS pct_child_first FROM joined GROUP BY child_category, parent_category ORDER BY parent_category, n_child_channels DESC, child_category
